column1: # #621: the per-line loop's tests of values fixed for the run (R), fixed for a
# file or a format (F), and first-observation latches over data (L), each
# located by a substring of its source line (every loop line carrying it is
# counted, each at its own execution count). tests = the number of such tests
# the line evaluates each time it runs.
# The session and user demand tests are reached only on a line carrying the
# field, so each is counted at its block's first statement (the demand is on
# by default, so every line that reaches the test enters the block).
